# Logs: reference

gash logs: find the log files that fill a disk and reclaim the space safely. The guide is [README.md](README.md); this page lists every command, shortcut and alias, as their own help prints it (`gash help NAME`, `gash COMMAND --help`).

## Command trees

### gash logs

```text

  gash logs · Find and reclaim disk space from log files

  COMMAND  USAGE  SHORTCUT  DESCRIPTION
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  clean                     Reclaim space: delete rotated logs, optionally trun…
  scan                      Report the log files eating disk, grouped by catego…

  Details: gash logs COMMAND --help · Guide: docs/logs/README.md
```

### gash logs clean

```text
Reclaim space: delete rotated logs, optionally truncate live ones

Usage:
  gash logs clean [PATH...] [flags]

Flags:
      --depth int               limit how deep each root is walked (0: no limit)
      --dry-run[=true|false]    show what would be freed, change nothing
  -h, --help[=true|false]       help for clean
      --json[=true|false]       one JSON object on stdout
      --min-size string         ignore files smaller than this (e.g. 1M, 512K)
      --older-than string       ignore files modified more recently than this (e.g. 7d, 48h)
      --sudo[=true|false]       reclaim root-owned logs too, with one sudo
      --truncate[=true|false]   also truncate live logs in place (keeps the file for running daemons)
  -y, --yes[=true|false]        do not ask for confirmation
```

### gash logs scan

```text
Report the log files eating disk, grouped by category

Usage:
  gash logs scan [PATH...] [flags]

Flags:
      --depth int           limit how deep each root is walked (0: no limit)
  -h, --help[=true|false]   help for scan
      --json[=true|false]   one JSON object on stdout
      --min-size string     ignore files smaller than this (e.g. 1M, 512K)
      --older-than string   ignore files modified more recently than this (e.g. 7d, 48h)
```
